mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_browse_history (user_id, content_id, browse_date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{browseDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE create_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT content_id FROM tb_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT bh.id, bh.user_id, bh.content_id, bh.browse_date, bh.create_time, bh.update_time, bh.is_deleted FROM tb_browse_history bh WHERE bh.id > #{watermarkId} AND bh.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_browse_history earlier WHERE earlier.user_id = bh.user_id AND earlier.content_id = bh.content_id AND earlier.id < bh.id ) ORDER BY bh.id LIMIT #{batchSize}
